reader.requirement: At --std 85 a declarative may appear in any program (containing, contained or separately compiled); it runs when its USE condition occurs during that program's execution; only declaratives of the program containing the failing statement qualify (plus, by X.5.5.4 GR1, a containing program's USE GLOBAL ones, nearest first); if none qualifies none runs.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses USE Format 3/4 (EC model, COBOL0877) and Format 1 without AFTER/PROCEDURE below 2002
DialectLevel >= 2002 adds the SORT GR17 exit filter to an EC-free __RunUse; 1985 takes the bare try/finally invoker (same dispatch, same return to the caller)

Year < 2002: the 1985 mandatory INVALID KEY/AT END phrase (COBOL6826) when no applicable USE exists; its HasApplicableUse test (BinderDriver.ContainerUsesOf = GLOBAL container USEs only) mirrors the GR1 scope

reader.edition-search: UseTierEmitter.EmitScopeTiers (file-name tier then open-mode tier), DispatchEmitter.EmitUseMachinery (__IoCheck), ProgramEmitter.EmitRunGlobalUse/ChainHasGlobalUse consult no edition: grep of Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|DialectBehavior|IsAtLeast over DispatchEmitter.cs, UseTierEmitter.cs, EcEmitter.cs, ProgramEmitter.cs, SequentialIoEmitter.cs, KeyedIoEmitter.cs, IoStatusClass.cs, ProcedureTableBuilder.cs; UseTierEmitter's remarks record the tiers as edition-invariant by determination (kb/Work PB344).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (for the selection; 1985 refuses the 2002 EC-model USE formats, which this rule does not cover)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf10_12 gives each program its own declarative; it does not exercise a contained program with no declarative under a non-GLOBAL container USE, a GLOBAL container USE, or a separately compiled callee with none

probes.expected: the container's non-GLOBAL USE ON INPUT does not run for the contained or the separately compiled program's failed OPEN; none is executed

probes.printed: OUTER-GLOBAL-DECL / A RESUMED 35 / B-OWN-DECL / B RESUMED 23 / SEP RESUMED 35 / OUT END
probes.expected: the container's USE GLOBAL serves a contained program without one; the contained program's own USE takes precedence; the separately compiled program gets none (X.5.5.4 GR1 a-c)

probes.printed: COBOL6826 at both READs of the programs with no applicable USE (the non-GLOBAL container USE is not counted)
probes.expected: §1985:IX.4.5.3 SR7 refusal: no applicable USE exists for those files

probes.printed: COBOL0878 exception-name EC-I-O requires --std 2002; COBOL0877 USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: the 2002 Format 3 USE is not 1985 source

citations.quoted: Only a declarative within the separately compiled program that contains the statement which caused the qualifying condition is invoked

reader.notes: Selection is the file-name tier, the open-mode tier, then the outward GLOBAL walk (__RunGlobalUse); it never crosses a CALL into a separately compiled program. Every probe printed what the 1985 text requires.

refuter.evidence: r1_prec.cob (--std 85, run dir refute-1985-100/r1_prec-001): a GLOBAL file and four contained programs with layered declaratives. Printed OUTER-GF-NAMED 23 for a contained program whose own declarative (ON OUTPUT) does not qualify (X.5.5.4 GR1a then b), OUTER-GLOBAL-IO for D's failed OPEN I-O when D's own USE GLOBAL ON OUTPUT does not qualify, D-GLOBAL-OUTPUT for the 22 in E (contained in D) and OUTER-GLOBAL-IO for E's failed OPEN I-O (rule c, two levels out). r1_ext.cob (r1_ext-001): an EXTERNAL indexed file in a separately compiled callee with no declaratives while the caller holds USE ON XF and USE ON INPUT: CALLEE RESUMED 35 / CALLEE IO RESUMED 35 with no caller declarative, then the caller's own OPEN gives CALLER-XF-NAMED 35. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IX.4.8.4 GR1  (4.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1' for 'If no qualifying declarative exists in the separately compiled program, no declarative is executed'; 'OK  §1985:X.5.5.4 GR1  (║5.5.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR1' for 'only the first qualifying declarative will be selected for execution'. Grep of DialectLevel|EditionContext|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|IsAtLeast over DispatchEmitter.cs, UseTierEmitter.cs, ProgramEmitter.cs, EcEmitter.cs finds only DispatchEmitter.cs:523 (the reader's EmitRunUseBody site). The contained-program precedence question for a file named by a container's GLOBAL USE is recorded under GR4.
